Round 1 — implementation on branch `fix/stale-pause-visibility` (PR #26; HEAD = "docs(phase-46): plan doc + roadmap entry", code in the commit before it, "fix(pause): make a held pause marker visible…"). No plan cycle: the arbiter asked for the implementation itself to be reviewed; the design is `docs/phases/stale-pause-visibility.md`.

Problem (docs/tagteam-issue-stale-pause-marker-2026-08-22.md): a `tagteam pause` marker is unbounded and was visible only in the watcher log; a 4-day-old pause silently held the next cycle's first turn on the aegis project (3.7.0). controls/watcher/headless unchanged since 3.7.0 → live on 3.8.1.

What changed:
- tagteam/headless.py: `pause_age(info)`, `describe_pause(info)` (`PAUSED (<age> ago, by <who>): <reason> [set on <phase>/<type> r<N>, status <s>]`), `handoff_pause_notice(root, next_agent)` — pure helpers next to read/write/clear_pause.
- tagteam/watcher.py `_log_paused`: uses describe_pause (aged + author); rate limit unchanged.
- tagteam/controls.py `pause_command`: records `state: {phase,type,round,status,turn,seq}` from read_state (best effort); one more output line (hold spans restarts and new cycles).
- tagteam/cycle.py: `_print_pause_notice(next_agent)` after `Cycle created` (always) and `Round added` (only when status.ready_for is truthy — closing writes stay silent); `_agent_name_for(role)`; `_dispatch_line()` → `dispatch:` on `cycle status`. All swallow exceptions (display must never fail a write). Gate still runs after the notice.
- tagteam/state.py: `state set` prints the notice when the resulting state is ready + lead/reviewer; `tagteam state` appends `Dispatch:`.
- SKILL.md (tagteam/data copy + repo copy, byte-identical): "Dispatch paused?" paragraph under As Lead step 3; one line under `/handoff start` step 3; `/handoff status` reads the `dispatch:` line.
- tests/test_controls.py `TestPauseVisibility` (8): age/describe incl. stale case and no "just now ago"; pause records state context; init notice / silent when unpaused; add notice only when a turn is handed (REQUEST_CHANGES→Claude, SUBMIT→Codex, APPROVE→silent); state set notice / silent on done; cycle status + state dispatch lines; watcher log aged.
- docs: issue doc copied verbatim with a resolution header; docs/phases/stale-pause-visibility.md; roadmap Phase 46 entry.

Not done, on purpose: auto-expiry/scoping of the marker (an arbiter pause must hold regardless of what agents write). Suggestion 5 (repeat /handoff on done) does not reproduce from the code (`_handle_done` sends one notice per state write; restarted watcher on done records-and-waits) — noted in the doc.

Verification: gate — see entry (scope is `skipped` by design here: no plan cycle → no implementation boundary; plan-doc ok). Manual smoke in a temp project: pause → init (note) → cycle status (dispatch: PAUSED …) → reviewer REQUEST_CHANGES (note names Claude) → resume → dispatch: not paused. Review by diff: `git diff main...fix/stale-pause-visibility`.

not checked — scope: no implementation boundary recorded (plan approved before 3.2.0, or a legacy cycle) — scope not enforced

One blocking compatibility issue:

- `tagteam/cycle.py::_cli_status` prints `dispatch: {_dispatch_line()}` only when `read_status()` returns a modern status. Its explicit legacy-markdown fallback prints state/ready_for/round/format and returns without a dispatch line. Legacy cycles are still a supported read path (`TestCLILegacyFallback`), and the phase's success criterion plus the updated `/handoff status` contract promise that `tagteam cycle status` shows dispatch state. Consequently, a held pause remains invisible through `cycle status` on legacy cycles—the exact failure mode this phase is meant to close.

Please print the same dispatch line in the legacy fallback and extend `test_cli_status_reads_legacy_md` (or add an equivalent test) to assert both unpaused and held-pause output. The focused `TestPauseVisibility` suite otherwise passes (8 passed), the submitted gate reports 1409 passed / 5 skipped at b893aa1, and the two SKILL.md copies are byte-identical.

Round 2 — addresses reviewer r1 (branch `fix/stale-pause-visibility` @ b92ba95 "fix(pause): cycle status prints dispatch: on the legacy-markdown path too").

- `tagteam/cycle.py::_cli_status`: the legacy-markdown fallback now prints `dispatch: {_dispatch_line()}` after `format: markdown (legacy)`, same line as the modern path, before returning. Nothing else in the function changed.
- `tests/test_cycle.py::TestCLILegacyFallback`: `test_cli_status_reads_legacy_md` now also asserts `dispatch: not paused`; new `test_cli_status_legacy_md_shows_held_pause` writes a marker (`by: jack`, reason `hand review`) and asserts `format: markdown (legacy)` + `dispatch: PAUSED (just now, by jack): hand review` + `tagteam resume` in the output.

Focused: tests/test_cycle.py -k Legacy + tests/test_controls.py -k PauseVisibility → 13 passed. gate: see entry @ b92ba95 (scope skipped by design — no plan cycle/boundary; plan-doc ok). Diff for review: `git diff b893aa1..b92ba95`.
